_comment: Expectations after running input.json under TMODE=ANSI or TMODE=TERA. Each assertion's bad-rows count must be 0. Conservative: focuses on tables existing and core invariants. Tighten as the canonical input.json's exact post-state stabilises.

assertions.name: tester_transaction exists with at least one row
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 AS x FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM tester_transaction) t WHERE t.c < 1

assertions.name: tester_campaign exists with at least one row
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 AS x FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM tester_campaign) t WHERE t.c < 1

assertions.name: tester_composite_table exists with at least one row
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 AS x FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM tester_composite_table) t WHERE t.c < 1

assertions.name: no tester_transaction rows have _fivetran_deleted=1 (deleted rows must be hard-deleted unless soft-delete mode)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 AS x FROM tester_transaction WHERE _fivetran_deleted = 1 AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM tester_transaction WHERE _fivetran_deleted = 0)

assertions.name: all tester_transaction rows have _fivetran_synced populated
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 AS x FROM tester_transaction WHERE _fivetran_synced IS NULL
